description: Tool to retrieve a single Account by its resource name. Use when you need detailed account info after confirming the account resource name (e.g., accounts/100).

inputSchema.description: Request model for retrieving a single Account.

name.description: Required. The resource name of the Account to retrieve. Must be in the exact format: accounts/{account_id} where account_id is a numeric identifier. IMPORTANT: Must start with 'accounts/' prefix, contain no forward slashes in the account_id, have no trailing slashes, and no additional path segments. Valid example: 'accounts/100'. Invalid examples: '100' (missing prefix), 'accounts/100/' (trailing slash), 'accounts/100/extra' (extra segments)
name.title: Name

inputSchema.title: GetAccountRequest

name: get_account

createTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the account was created.
createTime.title: Create Time

deleted.description: Whether this Account is soft-deleted. Deleted accounts are excluded from list results unless explicitly requested.
deleted.title: Deleted

displayName.description: Human-readable display name for this account.
displayName.title: Display Name

name.description: Resource name of this account. Format: accounts/{account_id}.
name.title: Name

updateTime.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the account was last updated.
updateTime.title: Update Time
